message.content:
The curve lies on a straight line:
\[
x=3t^2-9t-5=3(t^2-3t+2)-11=3y-11.
\]
So the paint trail is along the line \(x=3y-11\).

Now
\[
y=t^2-3t+2=\left(t-\frac32\right)^2-\frac14.
\]
For \(0\le t\le 4\), the minimum value is
\[
y_{\min}=-\frac14
\]
at \(t=\frac32\), and the maximum occurs at \(t=4\):
\[
y_{\max}=16-12+2=6.
\]
Thus the painted trail is the segment of the line from \(y=-\frac14\) to \(y=6\).

Since \(x=3y-11\), we have \(\frac{dx}{dy}=3\), so the length element along the line is
\[
ds=\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{dx}{dy}\right)^2}\,dy=\sqrt{1+9}\,dy=\sqrt{10}\,dy.
\]
Therefore the length of the paint trail is
\[
\int_{-1/4}^{6}\sqrt{10}\,dy
=\sqrt{10}\left(6+\frac14\right)
=\sqrt{10}\cdot \frac{25}{4}
=\frac{25\sqrt{10}}{4}.
\]

The answer is \(\frac{25\sqrt{10}}{4}\).
